title: Remote code execution in a widely used VPN appliance, exploited in the wild
summary: CISA added CVE-2026-20001 to the Known Exploited Vulnerabilities catalog. Unauthenticated attackers can execute code on the appliance. Patch deadline for US federal agencies is 21 days.

title: Phishing campaign against universities in Southeast Asia delivers ExampleRAT
summary: Emails impersonating a scholarship office lure staff to download a ZIP containing a malicious LNK file. The LNK runs PowerShell that installs ExampleRAT, which beacons to its C2 server.

title: ThreatFox: botnet C2 for ExampleBot
summary: Botnet command-and-control server reported by ThreatFox with 100% confidence.

title: Privilege escalation in a common Windows component
summary: CISA added CVE-2026-21345 to KEV. Local attackers can gain SYSTEM privileges; reported in ransomware intrusions.

title: Ransomware group leaks data from a regional logistics firm
summary: The group used stolen VPN credentials, then encrypted servers. File hash of the encryptor is listed.

title: URLhaus: malware download URL
summary: URL serving a malware payload, status online.

title: ExampleRAT
summary: Remote access trojan with keylogging and screenshot capability, first reported in 2025.

title: ThreatFox: phishing domain
summary: Credential-phishing domain imitating a webmail login page.
